description: The CA and TLS certificates of the CNPG cluster. The chart does not render this key yet, so it currently has no effect.

serverCASecret.description: Name of the secret that contains the CA certificate for the server certificates.

serverTLSSecret.description: Name of the secret that contains the TLS certificate for the server.

clientCASecret.description: Name of the secret that contains the CA certificate for the client certificates.

replicationTLSSecret.description: Name of the secret that contains the TLS certificate for streaming replication.

serverAltDNSNames.description: Additional DNS names to add to the server certificate.
